gorsel_html:
What is it?

Gambit tracked one operator running three open-source AI agents from scan to live card skimmer. Active since July, still running on Sep 22. 600,000 unexpired card records came out of two victims.

  • AgentsStrix · Cairn · Hermes
  • Decisionsclaude-opus-4.6, 121 skills
  • Cost per scan$25.46 mean, 101 runs
  • Victims119 sites · 27+ orgs in 6 days

How it works

  1. Strix scans: 146 runs, 138 hosts.
  2. The operator keeps sites on custom code.
  3. Cairn works each until shell or admin.
  4. Hermes plants the skimmer, then wipes data.

Impact stage (pseudo-code)

Reconstructed from Gambit's write-up.

# persona: "SOUL - Red Team Operator"
scan()            # strix
exploit()         # cairn
inject_skimmer()  # js, cdn, db, k8s
wipe_source_fields(batched)

Check it today

# scripts served through the CDN edge
$ curl -s https://shop.example.com/checkout \
    | grep -oE 'src="[^"]+"'
$ sha256sum dist/js/*.js
An origin-only check never sees a poisoned edge object.

How to defend

  • Hash every checkout script at the edge.
  • Alert on new script tags and CDN objects.
  • Watch DB fields and k8s specs for JS.
  • Back up order data before the wipe step.
The agent took the cards, then deleted your copy.
